BiblicalUsage: Bashac means to trample down, and Amos uses it against those who tread upon the poor and take wheat from them, warning that the stone houses they build will not be theirs to live in.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that trampling the poor is trampling the image of God, and Amos says the house built on it will stand empty.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
